newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 11.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 11.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Monday:
* Benchmark stock index expected to consolidate around the 10,000-point resistance level.
* Ben Lee, research chief, Nomura Securities: "Consolidation is seen as no apparent bellwether shares are expected to emerge to lead the overall upward momentum."
* "Electronics are still consolidating after sharp rally so far this year, while constructions' small weighting is not enough to boost overall momentum."
* Government to auction 182 million state-owned shares of steel giant China Steel in afternoon.
* Notebook computer maker Twinhead International to make debut, with listing price at T$67.5. Analysts said they expected Twinhead to rise to above T$100 in the near term.
* Index rose 0.70 percent/69.70 points to close at 9,993.54 points on Saturday.
